questions.html:
Which of the following statements is/are correct regarding integrated circuits (ICs)?

A. ICs typically contain discrete components that were fabricated on separate wafers.
B.ICs typically contain multiple layers of metals.
C. The transistors in an IC are typically made using Copper and Sulphur.
D. Having multiple metal layers in an IC typically simplifies the task of routing.

A. Abstraction decreases as we move from logical design to physical design.

C. The turnaround time for trying out multiple solutions is typically shorter when the abstraction is higher.

questions.html:
Which of the following statements is/are correct regarding hardware-software partitioning?
A. Hardware-software partitioning tries to exploit the distinct advantages of both hardware and software.
B. The functionality that needs frequent updating are typically implemented using dedicated hardware rather than software running on a general-purpose processor
C. The functionality that are the bottleneck for runtime are typically implemented using dedicated hardware rather than software running on a general-purpose processor.
D. The cost of a product typically decreases as we implement more functionality in dedicated hardware.

questions.html:
Which of the following statements is/are correct regarding behavior synthesis?
A. Behavior synthesis involves creating an RTL model (in a language such as Verilog) from an algorithmic description (in a language such as C).
B. Behavior synthesis instantiates transistors in the layout and makes connections.
C. Behavior synthesis typically ignores all constraints of resource usage, latency, throughput, area, and power.
D. Behavior synthesis can reduce area by sharing resources and trading off latency.
